A magma is a set with a binary operation. We need an infinite magma (M, ·) such that for any n ≥ 2 and any distinct elements x_1, ..., x_n ∈ M, all the "products" formed by parenthesizing x_1 · x_2 · ... · x_n (using each exactly once, in some order? or in the given order?) are distinct.
